hold_text: Tier 2: close-path journal writes on the live trader (order_monitor partial close + pending-pnl sweep) and scripts/ops/live_review_apply.py's Bybit reduce, real money included. (1) Every partial close books ONE closed child trades row (setup_type partial_close) with its own venue fill price, pnl and provenance, via the new src/runtime/partial_close_journal.py; an unread fill is booked pending and settled from the fills store by close order id. (2) A DEMO Bybit row's exit is priced from its OWN stop/target order before the first-fill read (real-money rows untouched). MEASURED basis: pkg-633f05fad1ee4c1d, where the 50% partial close's realised P&L landed on no row and its fill (9178f2b1 @1.0836) was booked as row 6983's exit instead of its own stop (bd8d3a72 @1.0629). Also adds the backfill TOOL (not run): system-action backfill-partial-close-children + scripts/ops/backfill_partial_close_children.py over the committed venue-verified plan docs/research/evidence/partial-close-backfill-plan-2026-11-12.json (2 true partials 6982/6983 + 6983's exit 1.0836->1.0629; 27 of 29 suspects excluded, entry filled the journal size). Dry-run by default; running it is a separate manager decision. The manager lands it. Revert: git revert.
why: PARTIAL-CLOSE-PNL-NOT-JOURNALED + DEMO-EXIT-FIRST-FILL-ATTRIBUTION: partial closes keep their realised P&L and the parent's remainder is priced from its own leg.
